command: uv run -- python scripts/api_reference_url_map.py --html '<built docs html dir>' --source-sha c52e06e6cea4b62f0a7794207fdd798c72dfe8da
policy: Every page URL is kept: the authored contract page replaces the .rst at the same path stem. Every id and name attribute in the built article body stays resolvable on the same page, as the id of a heading (disposition heading), as an alias id element next to the content that replaced it (alias), or as an alias that lands on an anchored not-part-of-public-contract note on the same page (alias-to-note) when the symbol is outside the public contract.
